{{Quote|I am honor-bound. If I must, I will give my life for my friend.|translated=1|Chewbacca|<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />}}
In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[First Wookiee Expeditionary Force|strike team]] led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] embarked on a '''mission''' aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] into the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] to rescue [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Chewbacca was bound by a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to Solo, but had been away from his friend to attend the coming-of-age [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|hrrtayyk ceremony]] of his son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. When he learned that Solo had been captured by the [[Duskhan League]], who were based out of Koornacht, he took Solo's ''Millennium Falcon'' to the League's power base of [[N'zoth]] and reluctantly took a Wookiee crew with him that included Lumpawarrump. After receiving intelligence on the League from the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Formayj]] at [[Esau's Ridge]] on [[Tholatin]] that was secretly channeled to them by the New Republic Intelligence agency [[Alpha Blue]], the Wookiees arrived over N'zoth and stormed the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Pride of Yevetha'']]. They rescued Solo, and Lumpawarrump completed his hrrtayyk.
